name: Alcadeias, Lord of Spirits
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Angel Commands.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
Players can't cast spells other than light spells.
flavorText: We have watched and we have waited. Now we act.

name: Astral Warper
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Cyber Viruses.
When you put this creature into the battle zone, draw up to 3 cards.
flavorText: Can you even comprehend the overwhelming intellectual advantage I have over you?

name: Trox, General of Destruction
rulesText:
When you put this creature into the battle zone, your opponent discards a card at random from his hand for each other darkness creature you have in the battle zone.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: Say goodbye to the daytime.

name: Doboulgyser, Giant Rock Beast
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Rock Beasts.
When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may destroy one of your opponent's creatures that has power 3000 or less.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: It doesn't bleed. It erupts.

name: Supporting Tulip
rulesText: Each Angel Command in the battle zone has "power attacker +4000." (While attacking, a creature that has "power attacker +4000" gets +4000 power.)
flavorText: They only bloom in outer space.

name: Aeris, Flight Elemental
rulesText:
This creature can't attack players.
This creature can attack untapped darkness creatures.
flavorText: "All armies, move out! It's time to make Photocide see the light!"

name: Amber Grass
rulesText: Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
flavorText: Each surge of electricity triggers a growth spurt.

name: Fu Reil, Seeker of Storms
rulesText: Player's can't use the "shield trigger" abilities of darkness cards.
flavorText: "The only smoke screen coming from Ballom will be the one billowing off of his smoldering carcass."

name: Full Defensor
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this spell is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may cast it immediately for no cost.)
Until the start of your next turn, each of your creatures in the battle zone gets "Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle)."

name: Gulan Rias, Speed Guardian
rulesText:
This creature can't be attacked by darkness creatures.
This creature can't be blocked by darkness creatures.
flavorText: It outraces shooting stars.

name: Kolon, the Oracle
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone and tap it.

name: Milieus, the Daystretcher
rulesText:
Blocker (When an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
Each darkness creature costs 2 more to summon, and each darkness spell costs 2 more to cast.

name: Mist Rias, Sonic Guardian
rulesText: Whenever another creature is put into the battle zone, you may draw a card.
flavorText: "When you shine a light into a dark corner, the shadow instantly vanishes. This should be an easy war."

name: Ouks, Vizier of Restoration
rulesText: When this creature would be destroyed, add it to your shields face down instead.
flavorText: "Laser web'? Check. 'Laser spider'? Still on order."

name: Re Bil, Seeker of Archery
rulesText:
Each other light creature in the battle zone gets +2000 power.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: Bull's-eye!

name: Sarius, Vizier of Suppression
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack players.
flavorText: It's got a heart of gold. And a gall bladder of zinc.

name: Screaming Sunburst
rulesText: Tap all creatures in the battle zone except light creatures.
flavorText: Forty megatons of happiness.

name: Whisking Whirlwind
rulesText: At the end of the turn, untap all your creatures in the battle zone.
flavorText: Get ready for a bad hair day.

name: Aqua Guard
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
This creature can't attack.
flavorText: This ocean ain't big enough for the two of us!

name: Aqua Jolter
rulesText: Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
flavorText: Saltwater makes me thirsty.

name: Clone Factory
rulesText: Return up to 2 cards from your mana zone to your hand.
flavorText: The factory works day and night, laboring at endeavors best left unknown.

name: Hunter Cluster
rulesText:
Blocker (Whenever an opponent's creature attacks, you may tap this creature to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)

name: Hydro Hurricane
rulesText:
For each light creature you have in the battle zone, you may choose a card in your opponent's mana zone and return it to his hand.
For each darkness creature you have in the battle zone, you may choose one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone and return it to his hand.

name: Keeper of the Sunlit Abyss
rulesText: Light creatures and darkness creatures in the battle zone each get +1000 power.
flavorText: Why do light and dark fight as they do? The more friends you have, the more birthday presents you get!

name: Marinomancer
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may reveal the top 3 cards of your deck. Put all light cards and all darkness cards from the revealed cards into your hand, and put the rest into your graveyard.
flavorText: I don't know who will win the war. But I know I'm on their side.

name: Smile Angler
rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may choose a card in your opponent's mana zone and return it to his hand.
flavorText: I love the ocean! I love fish! I love rocks! I love being an artificial monstrosity constructed by the Cyber Lords! Everything is great!

name: Chains of Sacrifice
rulesText:
Destroy up to 2 of your opponent's creatures.
Destroy one of your creatures.
flavorText: "The only thing stronger than my chains is your fear." —Trox, General of Destruction

name: Darkpact
rulesText: Put any number of cards from your mana zone into your graveyard. Then draw that many cards.
flavorText: "Why don't mortals embrace despair? All my ghoul friends really seem to enjoy it." —Ballom, Master of Death

name: Gigabolver
rulesText: Players can't use the "shield trigger" abilities of light cards.
flavorText: It looks like a hideous monster, but there's really a sweet little girl deep down inside. In its stomach.

name: Gregoria, Princess of War
rulesText: Each Demon Command in the battle zone gets +2000 power and has "blocker." (Whenever one of your opponent's creatures attacks, you may tap a creature that has "blocker" to stop the attack. Then the 2 creatures battle.)
flavorText: Those fools in the clouds had better learn to like eternal midnight.

name: Gregorian Worm
rulesText: Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
flavorText: To a Gregorian worm, the world falls into two categories: things it can eat, and . . . Well, so far there's just the one category.

name: Locomotiver
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
When you put this creature into the battle zone, your opponent discards a card at random from his hand.
flavorText: If you think that's scary, you should see the caboose.

name: Mongrel Man
rulesText: Whenever another creature is destroyed, you may draw a card.
flavorText: "Shut off a light for a split second, and darkness rushes in to fill the void. This should be an easy war."

name: Photocide, Lord of the Wastes
rulesText:
This creature can't attack players.
This creature can attack untapped light creatures.
flavorText: "I will snuff out the sun and the stars! Then I'll move on to the candles and the lanterns. If I have time, I'll take care of those glow sticks people wear around thier necks. But the sun is first!"

name: Purple Piercer
rulesText:
This creature can't be attacked by light creatures.
This creature can't be blocked by light creatures.
flavorText: You do not want to get into a tickle fight with this thing.

name: Shadow Moon, Cursed Shade
rulesText: Each other darkness creature in the battle zone gets +2000 power.
flavorText: It spins a web of evil spells, all for its mistress, the Princess of War.

name: Skeleton Thief, the Revealer
rulesText: When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may return a Living Dead from your graveyard to your hand.
flavorText: I've dug up a pelvis, five kneecaps, and a bucketful of ribs tonight. But I still can't find any hands!

name: Soul Gulp
rulesText: Your opponent chooses and discards a card from his hand for each light creature he has in the battle zone.
flavorText: The first victim of the war between light and dark was the sky.

name: Volcano Smog, Deceptive Shade
rulesText: Each light creature costs 2 more to summon, and each light spell costs 2 more to cast.
flavorText: "Is there any word more meaningless than 'hope'? Besides 'blarfurgsnarg,' of course."

name: Blasto, Explosive Soldier
rulesText: While you have a darkness creature in the battle zone, this creature gets +2000 power.
flavorText: "How dare you doubt me? I have called for reinforcements...from the Fire Realm." — Trox, General of Destruction

name: Chaotic Skyterror
rulesText: Each Demon Command in the battle zone has "power attacker +4000" and "double breaker." (A creature that has "power attacker +4000" and "double breaker" gets +4000 power while attacking and breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: I taught Trox and Ballom a trick. Now they breathe fire.

name: Kamikaze, Chainsaw Warrior
rulesText: Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
flavorText: With these chainsaws, shredding a forest is easy. But eating a steak is hard.

name: Magmarex
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
When you put this creature into the battle zone, destroy all creatures that have power 1000.
flavorText: Is it hot in here, or is it just me? Oh . . . right.

name: Mega Detonator
rulesText: Discard any number of cards from your hand. Then choose the same number of your creatures in the battle zone. Each of those creatures gets "double breaker" until the end of the turn. (A creature that has "double breaker" breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: "They don't call me an arms dealer for nothing." —Engineer Pipo

name: Missile Boy
rulesText: Each light creature costs 1 more to summon, and each light spell costs 1 more to cast.
flavorText: Ladies and gentlemen, hello . . . and goodbye!

name: Pippie Kuppie
rulesText: Each Armored Dragon in the battle zone gets +1000 power.
flavorText: When a Fire Bird senses a Dragon in trouble, the whole flock rises into the air, chirps "kuripppie," and dashes to the rescue.

name: Sword of Malevolent Death
rulesText: Until the end of the turn, each of your creatures in the battle zone gets "While attacking, this creature gets +1000 power for each darkness card in your mana zone."
flavorText: Ballom gives his armies haunted swords, each with a soul trapped inside.

name: Ancient Giant
rulesText:
This creature can't be blocked by darkness creatures.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: "I don't care how hugely, massively, gigantically big it is! Stop it before it gets to General Trox!" —Zagaan, Knight of Darkness

name: Cannon Shell
rulesText:
Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
This creature gets +1000 power for each shield you have.
flavorText: It has hungered for revenge since the Dark Lords invaded.

name: Dew Mushroom
rulesText: Each darkness creature costs 1 more to summon, and each darkness spell costs 1 more to cast.
flavorText: "The only thing grosser than eating a mushroom is having a mushroom eat me." —Giliam the Tormentor

name: Exploding Cactus
rulesText: While you have a light creature in the battle zone, this creature gets +2000 power.
flavorText: "Eww! Now that's disgusting." — Mongrel Man

name: Mystic Inscription
rulesText: Add the top card of your deck to your shields face down.
flavorText: "The Angel Commands have sent us a divine message! Let's see: 'Ice cream, rye bread, bananas, laundry detergent . . .'"

name: Sword of Benevolent Life
rulesText: Each of your creatures in the battle zone gets +1000 power until the end of the turn for each light creature you have in the battle zone.
flavorText: "Alcadeias has given us a great gift! We're saved! We're...ummm, can anyone lift that thing?" — Fear Fang

name: Three-Eyed Dragonfly
rulesText: Whenever this creature attacks, you may destroy one of your other creatures. If you do, this creature gets +2000 power and has "double breaker" until the end of the turn. (A creature that has "double breaker" breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: The third eye sees a few seconds into the future.

name: Torcon
rulesText: Shield trigger (When this creature is put into your hand from your shield zone, you may summon it immediately for no cost.)
flavorText: This ritual seeds the sky with lightning, rips infected trees up by the roots, and turns me a rockin' shade of blue.

name: Rimuel, Cloudbreak Elemental
rulesText:
When you put this creature into the battle zone, tap one of your opponent's creatures in the battle zone for each untapped light card in your mana zone.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: As the sun streams through the clouds, so shall some other poetic stuff happen.

name: King Aquakamui
rulesText:
When you put this creature into the battle zone, you may return all Angel Commands and all Demon Commands from your graveyard to your hand.
Angel Commands and Demon Commands in the battle zone each get +2000 power.
flavorText: He drifts along the currents of war.

name: Ballom, Master of Death
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Demon Commands.
When you put this creature into the battle zone, destroy all creatures except darkness creatures.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: You see a world. I see a graveyard-to-be.

name: Galklife Dragon
rulesText:
When you put this creature into the battle zone, destroy all light creatures that have power 4000 or less.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
flavorText: Let the skies burn.

name: Niofa, Horned Protector
rulesText:
Evolution—Put on one of your Horned Beasts.
When you put this creature into the battle zone, search your deck. You may take a nature creature from your deck, show that creature to your opponent, and put it into your hand. Then shuffle your deck.
Double breaker (This creature breaks 2 shields.)
